measures.name: Base Cases Unique

measures.name: Base Lives All

measures.name: Base Lives Unique

    VALUES ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[dimpolicykey] ),
    CALCULATE ( MAX ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[livecount_clean] ) )
)

measures.name: Base Premium All

measures.name: Base Premium Unique
measures.expression:
SUMX (
    VALUES ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[dimpolicykey] ),
    CALCULATE ( MAX ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[est_annual_premium] ) )
)

RETURN

        CountMode,
        1, [Base Cases All],
        2, [Base Cases Unique],

    )

measures.name: Selected Metric

        MetricChoice,
        1, [Cases],
        2, [Lives],
        3, [Premium],

    )

measures.name: Selected Metric Label
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_metric[metric_name], "Cases" )

measures.name: Selected Mode Label
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_count_mode[mode_name], "All Events" )

measures.name: Metric By Date Basis
measures.expression:
VAR DateBasis = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_date_basis[basis_key], 1 )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        DateBasis,
        1, [Selected Metric],
        2, CALCULATE (
               [Selected Metric],
               USERELATIONSHIP (
                   gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[termination_date_key],
                   gold_dim_date[date_key]
               ),
               USERELATIONSHIP (
                   gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[case_tenure_termination_key],
                   gold_dim_case_tenure[case_tenure_key]
               )
           ),
        [Selected Metric]
    )

measures.name: Selected Date Basis Label
measures.expression: SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_date_basis[basis_name], "Processed Date" )

measures.name: Data Boundary Date
measures.expression:
VAR DateBasis = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_date_basis[basis_key], 1 )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        DateBasis,
        1, CALCULATE (
               MAX ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histdate] ),
               REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_dim_date )
           ),
        2, CALCULATE (
               MAX ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histtermdt] ),
               REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_dim_date )
           ),
        CALCULATE (
            MAX ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histdate] ),
            REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_dim_date )
        )
    )

measures.name: Is Period Complete
measures.expression:
VAR Boundary     = [Data Boundary Date]
VAR PeriodEnd    = MAX ( gold_dim_date[date] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( Boundary ) || ISBLANK ( PeriodEnd ), TRUE(), PeriodEnd <= Boundary )

measures.name: Period Completeness Note
measures.expression:
IF (
    [Is Period Complete],
    BLANK(),
    "Partial period — data through " & FORMAT ( [Data Boundary Date], "d MMM yyyy" )
)

measures.name: Metric Prior Year
measures.expression:
VAR CalendarView =
    COALESCE (
        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Calendar Axis'[Calendar Axis Order] ),
        SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_calendar_view[view_key] ),
        2
    )VAR Boundary      = [Data Boundary Date]
VAR PeriodStart   = MIN ( gold_dim_date[date] )
VAR PeriodEnd     = MAX ( gold_dim_date[date] )
VAR PriorStart    = IF ( CalendarView = 1, PeriodStart - 364, EDATE ( PeriodStart, -12 ) )
VAR PriorEndRaw   = IF ( CalendarView = 1, PeriodEnd - 364,   EDATE ( PeriodEnd, -12 ) )
VAR PriorBoundary = IF ( CalendarView = 1, Boundary - 364,    EDATE ( Boundary, -12 ) )
VAR PriorEnd      = MIN ( PriorEndRaw, PriorBoundary )
RETURN
    CALCULATE (
        [Metric By Date Basis],
        REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_dim_date ),
        gold_dim_date[date] >= PriorStart,
        gold_dim_date[date] <= PriorEnd
    )

measures.name: Metric YoY Change
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentY = [Metric By Date Basis]
VAR PriorY   = [Metric Prior Year]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( PriorY ) || PriorY = 0, BLANK(), CurrentY - PriorY )

measures.name: Metric YoY %
measures.expression:
IF (
    ISFILTERED ( gold_dim_date[year] ),
    DIVIDE ( [Metric By Date Basis] - [Metric Prior Year], [Metric Prior Year] )
)

measures.name: Period Label
measures.expression:
VAR CalendarView =
    COALESCE (
        SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Calendar Axis'[Calendar Axis Order] ),
        SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_param_calendar_view[view_key] ),
        2
    )
VAR YearSel = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_date[year] )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        CalendarView,
        1, COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_date[year_week] ),    "Year " & YearSel, "All periods" ),
        2, COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_date[year_month] ),   "Year " & YearSel, "All periods" ),
        3, COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_date[year_quarter] ), "Year " & YearSel, "All periods" ),
        4, COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_date[year] ),         "All periods" ),
        COALESCE ( SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_date[year_month] ), "Year " & YearSel, "All periods" )
    )

measures.name: Cancellations
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Metric By Date Basis],
    gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histclass] = "C"
)

measures.name: Reinstatements
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Metric By Date Basis],
    gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histclass] = "R"
)

measures.name: % Cases Reinstated
measures.expression:
VAR Cancels  = [Cancellations]
VAR Reinsts  = [Reinstatements]
RETURN
    DIVIDE ( Reinsts, Cancels )

measures.name: Last Refresh Date
measures.expression: FORMAT ( MAX ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[_processed_at] ), "dd MMM yyyy" )

measures.name: KPI Card Title
measures.expression: "Cancellations — " & [Selected Metric Label] & " (" & [Selected Mode Label] & ")"

measures.name: NY Concentration
measures.expression:
VAR NYValue = CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[statewritten] = "NY" )
VAR Total   = CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[statewritten] ) )
RETURN DIVIDE ( NYValue, Total )

measures.name: Share Of Total
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Metric By Date Basis],
    CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement ) )
)

measures.name: KPI Card Title Recovery
measures.expression: "Reinstatements — " & [Selected Metric Label] & " (" & [Selected Mode Label] & ")"

measures.name: Recovery Rate
measures.expression:
VAR Reinsts = CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histclass] = "R" )
VAR Cancels = CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[histclass] = "C" )
RETURN DIVIDE ( Reinsts, Cancels )

measures.name: Drillthrough Context
measures.expression:
VAR Product = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[policytype_display], "All products" )
VAR Reason  = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[termination_reason], "All reasons" )
VAR Size    = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[case_size], "All case sizes" )
VAR Tenure  = SELECTEDVALUE ( gold_dim_case_tenure[case_tenure_band], "All tenures" )
RETURN
    Product & "  ·  " & Reason & "  ·  " & Size & "  ·  " & Tenure

measures.name: Alt Context
measures.expression:
"Showing " & LOWER ( [Selected Metric Label] )
    & ", counted as " & LOWER ( [Selected Mode Label] )
    & ", by " & LOWER ( [Selected Date Basis Label] )
    & ", for " & [Period Label] & ". "

measures.name: Alt Partial Note
measures.expression:
IF (
    [Is Period Complete],
    "",
    "Note: the latest period is incomplete, with data through "
        & FORMAT ( [Data Boundary Date], "d MMMM yyyy" ) & ". "
)

measures.name: Alt Bar By Product
measures.expression:
VAR Ctx = [Alt Context]
VAR Total = CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[policytype_display] ) )
VAR Ranked =
    TOPN (
        3,
        SUMMARIZE (
            gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement,
            gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[policytype_display],
            "@val", [Metric By Date Basis]
        ),
        [@val], DESC
    )
VAR Described =
    CONCATENATEX (
        Ranked,
        gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[policytype_display]
            & " at " & FORMAT ( [@val], "#,0" )
            & " (" & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [@val], Total ), "0.0%" ) & ")",
        ", ", [@val], DESC
    )
VAR CatCount = CALCULATE ( DISTINCTCOUNT ( gold_fact_cancel_reinstatement[policytype_display] ) )
RETURN
    Ctx & "Bar chart of " & CatCount & " products. The largest are "
        & Described & ". " & [Alt Partial Note]

measures.name: Alt Bar By Tenure
measures.expression:
VAR Total = CALCULATE ( [Metric By Date Basis], REMOVEFILTERS ( gold_dim_case_tenure ) )
VAR Described =
    CONCATENATEX (
        SUMMARIZE (
            gold_dim_case_tenure,
            gold_dim_case_tenure[case_tenure_band],
            gold_dim_case_tenure[sort_order],
            "@val", [Metric By Date Basis]
        ),
        gold_dim_case_tenure[case_tenure_band] & " "
            & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [@val], Total ), "0.0%" ),
        ", ", gold_dim_case_tenure[sort_order], ASC
    )
RETURN
    [Alt Context] & "Bar chart of case tenure bands, in order from newest to oldest: "
        & Described & ". " & [Alt Partial Note]

measures.name: Alt Trend Chart
measures.expression:
VAR Total    = [Metric By Date Basis]
VAR Prior    = [Metric Prior Year]
VAR Periods  = CALCULATE ( DISTINCTCOUNT ( gold_dim_date[year_month] ) )
VAR PeakVal  = MAXX ( VALUES ( gold_dim_date[year_month] ), [Metric By Date Basis] )
VAR PeakName =
    MAXX (
        FILTER ( VALUES ( gold_dim_date[year_month] ), [Metric By Date Basis] = PeakVal ),
        gold_dim_date[year_month]
    )
RETURN
    [Alt Context]
        & "Column chart across " & Periods & " periods, with a line showing change against prior year. "
        & "Total is " & FORMAT ( Total, "#,0" )
        & " against " & FORMAT ( Prior, "#,0" ) & " last year. "
        & "The highest period is " & PeakName & " at " & FORMAT ( PeakVal, "#,0" ) & ". "
        & [Alt Partial Note]

measures.name: Alt NP Chart
measures.expression:
[Alt Context]
    & "Column chart comparing cancellations against reinstatements, with a recovery rate line. "
    & FORMAT ( [Cancellations], "#,0" ) & " cancelled for non-payment, "
    & FORMAT ( [Reinstatements], "#,0" ) & " reinstated, "
    & "a recovery rate of " & FORMAT ( [% Cases Reinstated], "0.0%" ) & ". "
    & [Alt Partial Note]

measures.name: Alt Detail Table
measures.expression:
"Table of individual policy records. "
    & FORMAT ( [Cases], "#,0" ) & " rows shown. "
    & "Filtered to: " & [Drillthrough Context] & ". "
    & "Columns are policy number, policy name, effective date, termination date, "
    & "processed date, class, reason, product, bill mode, state, lives, premium, "
    & "case size, broker and sales rep."

measures.name: Alt KPI Card
measures.expression:
[Alt Context]
    & "The total is " & FORMAT ( [Metric By Date Basis], "#,0" ) & ". "
    & IF (
        ISBLANK ( [Metric YoY %] ),
        "No prior year comparison is available. ",
        "That is " & FORMAT ( ABS ( [Metric YoY %] ), "0.0%" )
            & IF ( [Metric YoY %] < 0, " lower", " higher" )
            & " than the same period last year. "
      )
    & [Alt Partial Note]

measures.name: Alt Stacked Mix
measures.expression:
[Alt Context]
    & "Stacked column chart showing how the mix changes across periods. "
    & "The top six categories are shown; smaller categories are excluded. "
    & "Total across all periods is " & FORMAT ( [Metric By Date Basis], "#,0" ) & ". "
    & [Alt Partial Note]

measures.name: Alt Recovery Bar
measures.expression:
[Alt Context]
    & "Bar chart of recovery rate. Overall recovery rate is "
    & FORMAT ( [% Cases Reinstated], "0.0%" )
    & ", from " & FORMAT ( [Cancellations], "#,0" ) & " cancellations and "
    & FORMAT ( [Reinstatements], "#,0" ) & " reinstatements. "
    & [Alt Partial Note]
